input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. The United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods does not apply.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects New York law with a CISG waiver, and Section 28.2 gives the state and federal courts in New York County exclusive jurisdiction with mutual submission to personal jurisdiction and a carve-out preserving injunctive relief elsewhere. A document-wide search returns no arbitration provision, so there is no foreign seat or mandatory arbitration. The pre-filing executive escalation in Section 28.3 expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings. This matches our preferred position exactly, so no redline is needed.
